cases.subject: Zostań liderem rynku: pakiet VIP dla wybranych firm
cases.body:
Szanowni Panstwo,

Premium Leads Pro zaprasza wybrane firmy transportowe i magazynowe do programu VIP, ktory zmienia zasady gry na rynku! Dzieki naszemu systemowi Panstwa firma bedzie widoczna w kazdej wyszukiwarce, w mediach spolecznosciowych i w skrzynkach tysiecy potencjalnych klientow, a Panstwo nie musza robic zupelnie nic. Wszystko robi nasz zespol oraz nasze roboty.

Co zawiera pakiet VIP? Po pierwsze, pozycjonowanie strony na 30 najwazniejszych fraz, z gwarancja pierwszej strony w wynikach. Po drugie, baze 900000 kontaktow do firm z calej Europy, gotowa do wysylki w kilka minut. Po trzecie, kampanie reklamowe w mediach spolecznosciowych na dziewiec miesiecy. Po czwarte, osobistego opiekuna, ktory odpowiada na pytania przez dwadziescia cztery godziny na dobe. Po piate, szkolenie dla calego zespolu sprzedazy, prowadzone przez ekspertow z naszej firmy.

Cena pakietu to normalnie 1990 euro, ale dla firm, ktore odpowiedza do piatku, wynosi tylko 290 euro. Oferujemy rowniez gwarancje zwrotu pieniedzy w ciagu 60 dni, bez pytan. Nasi klienci podwajaja sprzedaz srednio w dwa miesiace. Odpowiedz TAK na ten mail, a nasz doradca zadzwoni jeszcze dzis, aby podpisac umowe. Takiej okazji nie bedzie juz w tym roku! Prosimy tez o nieprzekazywanie tej wiadomosci konkurencji, poniewaz oferta jest przeznaczona tylko dla wybranych firm.

cases.subject: Your business deserves more customers: here is how
cases.body:
Dear Business Owner,

Are you looking for more customers but you do not have time to search for them? Premium Leads Pro takes care of everything for you. We are the number one provider of business leads in Europe, and today we have a special offer which ends on Sunday at midnight. For only 59 euro you receive a verified database of 700,000 companies in logistics, retail, food and production, with the name of the manager, the email and the size of the company.

Why is our database better than the others? First, it is updated every week by our team and by our robots. Second, it is sorted by country and industry, so you can write only to the people who matter. Third, we give you a ready template of the offer in five languages. Fourth, we include a free audit of your website with a list of mistakes that make your company invisible in search engines. And fifth, we give you a full refund in thirty days if you are not happy, no questions asked.

Hundreds of companies already doubled their sales after using our files, and many of them come back every month. Do not wait until your competitors take the best contacts. Just reply to this message with the word YES and we will send you the invoice and the download details within five minutes. Thank you for your trust, we wait for your answer today!

cases.subject: Your company won a fleet package: claim it today

Dear Customer,

Congratulations! The Paliwa-Flota Billing Department has selected your company as a winner of our yearly Fleet Package draw, among more than four thousand participating companies in the region. The prize includes five thousand litres of diesel, a set of new fuel cards with higher monthly limits, free roadside assistance for twelve months and an insurance voucher for every vehicle in your fleet.

To claim the prize, you must verify the company profile in the secure panel, which opens after you press the button in this message. The panel will ask you for the name of an authorised person, the tax number of the company, and the bank account to which we should send the cash equivalent of the voucher. The whole process takes only a few minutes, and our system confirms the prize at once.

Please note that the prize must be claimed within 48 hours. After this time the draw is repeated and your company will lose the prize without any compensation. We kindly ask you not to forward this message to other persons in your company and not to contact your account manager, because the draw is run by the central billing team and the manager does not know about it. Co dostajecie w cenie?
